rule-1-7-a.test_description: A one story building's baseline and proposed RMDs have matching values as determined by Table G3.1(1) Baseline Building Performance and https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/schema-source/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.yaml.

standard.rule_description: The proposed design shall be the same as the baseline design for all data elements identified to be the same between the proposed model and baseline model in the schema hosted at data.standards.ashrae {{https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/docs229/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.json}}

rule-1-7-b.test_description: A one story building's baseline and proposed RMDs fail to have matching list lengths for value determined by Table G3.1(1) Baseline Building Performance and https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/schema-source/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.yaml.
rule-1-7-b.expected_raised_message_includes: List length mismatch (Proposed: [2] vs. Baseline: [1]) path: $.ruleset_model_descriptions[0].buildings[0].building_segments[0].zones

standard.rule_description: The proposed design shall be the same as the baseline design for all data elements identified to be the same between the proposed model and baseline model in the schema hosted at data.standards.ashrae {{https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/docs229/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.json}}

rule-1-7-c.test_description: A one story building's baseline and proposed RMDs fail to have matching IDs in their lists for value determined by Table G3.1(1) Baseline Building Performance and https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/schema-source/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.yaml.
rule-1-7-c.expected_raised_message_includes: Baseline model is missing object with id 'Thermal Zone One' at path: $.ruleset_model_descriptions[0].buildings[0].building_segments[0].zones

standard.rule_description: The proposed design shall be the same as the baseline design for all data elements identified to be the same between the proposed model and baseline model in the schema hosted at data.standards.ashrae {{https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/docs229/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.json}}

rule-1-7-d.test_description: A one story building's baseline and proposed RMDs fail to have matching IDs for a non-array value that should match as determined by Table G3.1(1) Baseline Building Performance and https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/schema-source/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.yaml.

standard.rule_description: The proposed design shall be the same as the baseline design for all data elements identified to be the same between the proposed model and baseline model in the schema hosted at data.standards.ashrae {{https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/docs229/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.json}}

rule-1-7-e.test_description: A one story building's proposed RMD has a different quantity of HVAC systems, contains additional terminals for DOAS/baseboard, has additional window subsurfaces, and has different schedules, materials, and constructions than the baseline RMD. All of these differences are permitted by Table G3.1(1) Baseline Building Performance and https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/schema-source/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.yaml.

standard.rule_description: The proposed design shall be the same as the baseline design for all data elements identified to be the same between the proposed model and baseline model in the schema hosted at data.standards.ashrae {{https://github.com/open229/ruleset-model-description-schema/blob/main/docs229/ASHRAE229_extra.schema.json}}
